rooms.description: You are standing in a darkened room inside a small bark hut. There is a door to the north, leading out into a forest clearing.

You are in a forest clearing before a small bark hut. There are no windows and the door to the south is locked. The latch engaged when you closed the door. The forest lies to the west and a field of clovers opens to the east.
You are deep in a dark forest. In the distance you can see a mighty river, its waters glinting through the trees. The path leads east to the hut clearing and west towards a cliff above the river.
You are standing in a field of four-leafed clovers. The hut clearing is to the west and the lower slopes of Mount Ymir rise to the east.
The forest has opened up at this point. You are standing on a cliff overlooking a wide glacial river. A small foot-beaten path leads south to the riverbank. The forest path leads east.
You are standing at the rocky edge of the mighty river Gioll. The path forks east and west while a small path climbs north to the cliff.

You are on the edge of an enormous crater. The rim is extremely slippery. Clouds of water vapour rise high in the air as the Gioll pours into it. To the west is a fatal drop; the safe path leads east.

The path stops here. You are on a rocky outcrop, projecting about fifteen feet above the river. In the distance, a tiny string bridge spans the water to the south-east. To reach it, you must return west and take the detour through the forest.

You are on the lower slopes of Mount Ymir. The forest stretches far away to the west. Arctic winds blow fiercely; it is very cold! A path leads west to the clover field and another descends south towards the bridge.
You stand on a rocky precipice high above the river Gioll. Mount Ymir stands to the north. A flimsy string bridge spans the mighty river to the south; the path north leads to the mountain slopes.
You have made your way halfway across the creaking bridge. It sways violently from side to side above the river! Hold tight and follow it either north or south.
You are on the southern edge of the mighty river, before the string bridge. The bridge leads north, an oak forest lies to the west and a path follows the bank east to a cliff face.

You are standing on a rock in the middle of a mighty oak forest. Surrounding you are thousands of poisonous mushrooms. A path leads east to the bridge landing and another continues south to a clearing.
You are in a clearing in the forest. An ancient basalt rock formation towers above you. To your south is the entrance of a VERY interesting cave... The path north leads to the oak forest.
You are on a shelf against a cliff face, overlooking the river from its southern bank. The path west leads to the string bridge landing.

You are just inside the cave. Sunlight pours into the entrance, lighting a path to the east and another to the south. I don't mind saying I'm a bit scared! The way north leads outside. You will need a light before venturing deeper.
This passage appears to be a dead end. An earlier explorer has scratched a message on the wall before you: 'Find the Sacred Key of Thialfi'. The passage leads west to the cave entrance.
You are deep in a dark cavern. Daylight filters in from the cave entrance to the north. A passage leads west into what appears to be an old torture chamber.
You are in the legendary treasure room of the black elves of Svartalfheim. Every red-blooded Viking has dreamed of entering this sacred room! The only way out leads west through the doorway.
You can see a small oak doorway. Its heavy timber was bound with iron. The entrance looks formidable. A passage leads south to a cavern.
You are deep in a dark cavern. A passage leads north to an oak doorway and a draught comes from a corridor to the east. A long tunnel stretches south into the darkness.
You are standing in a corridor. You can feel a faint breeze stirring the stale air. The western passage leads to a dark cavern and a doorway to the south leads to the torture chamber.

You are standing in what appears to have once been a torture chamber. Apart from the rather comprehensive range of instruments of absolutely inhuman agony, coagulated blood stains on the walls and mangled bits of bone on the floor make me think that a number of would-be adventurers croaked it here! A corridor leads north and the entrance cavern lies to the east.
You stand in a long tunnel which has been bored out of the rock. It runs from north to south between a cavern and a large round chamber.
You are deep in a dark cavern. This small side cave is empty and very quiet. Its only passage leads west, back to the large round chamber.

You are in a large round room with a number of exits. The walls have been painted a mystical dark purple and a big chalk star is drawn in the centre of the floor. This is one of the hidden chambers of the infamous sect known as the monks of Loki. Norse folk believe them to be gods. A long tunnel leads north. A passage south leads to a river ledge. A passage leads west towards the bat caves and a small side cave opens to the east.
You are standing on a narrow ledge, high above a subterranean river. To the east is a balcony overlooking a huge cavern. The passage north leads to the round chamber.

You are on a balcony overlooking a huge cavern which has been converted into a temple. This temple has been dedicated to Loki, the god of fire, who came to live in Svartalfheim after he had been banished to exile by Odin. Since then he has been waiting for the 'End Of All Things'. A sturdy stone rail borders the balcony. The temple floor is below and a passage leads west to a river ledge.
You are deep in a dark cavern where the passages meet. A draught stirs the air. The round chamber lies to the east, a bat colony to the south and a forked stone pillar marks the passage west.
You are deep in a dark cavern beside a forked stone pillar. The junction lies to the east and a passage continues west into a pale limestone chamber.
You are deep in a dark cavern. Water drips from the roof of this low passage. It leads north to a pale limestone chamber and east to another chamber beyond.
You are deep in a dark cavern whose pale limestone walls catch the light. The passage east leads to a forked stone pillar while a low, dripping passage turns south.

You are in the central cave of a giant bat colony. Above you, hundreds of giant bats hang from the ceiling and the floor is covered in centuries of giant bat droppings. Careful where you step! Incidentally, the smell is indescribable. A junction lies north and a passage leads west to another chamber.
You are deep in a dark cavern beyond the bat colony. Passages lead east towards the roosting bats and west into a low, dripping passage.
You are in the temple. On the wall is a giant statue of Loki carved out of the living rock itself! A balcony stands high overhead.
You are deep in a dark cavern below the temple. A narrow shaft opens to the north while a passage east leads towards the sound of an underground river.

You stand in an old and musty crypt, the final resting place of hundreds of Loki's devotees. Putrefaction and decay fill the air here. Four stones on the eastern wall name its keeper. A gate leads south to the temple.
You are in a tiny cell. The passage west leads to the crypt while a ventilation shaft pierces the eastern wall. There is a service hatch to the north, but its latch is on the drain side.
You are deep in a dark cavern just beyond the ventilation shaft. The shaft leads west into the cell and a passage continues south into a lower cavern.

You are on another ledge high above a subterranean river. Water pours into the cavern through a hole in the roof to the north. The path north leads to the waterfall; south, it follows the ledge to a river bend. The cavern lies west. There is only a sheer drop to the east.
Somehow you have found your way into the complex drainage system of this entire cavern network! This straight drain leads west to a freezing conduit and east along the passage towards a junction.
You are in the complex drainage system of the cavern network. The straight passage runs between the conduit to the west and a junction to the east.

You are at a junction in the complex drainage system of the cavern network. A winding passage leads north towards a pearl-white chamber. A branch leads east and the drain west leads to the conduit. To the south is the cell's service hatch; you can OPEN HATCH here.
You are in a blind branch of the cavern's complex drainage system. There is no way onwards; the drain west leads to the junction.

You are standing near an enormous waterfall which brings water down from the surface, from the river Gioll. Stone steps climb north beside the falling water. The lower ledge lies south; there is no safe footing to the east.
You are deep in a dark cavern whose walls shine pearl-white in your light. Stone steps lie to the west. A winding passage leads south, changing height as it makes its way to a junction in the drains.
You are standing at the top of a stone staircase. The steps lead south towards the roar of the waterfall. To the east is a pearl-white chamber.

You are on a narrow and crumbling ledge at a bend in the river. Across the water to the east you can see a magic castle. Don't ask me why it is magic... I just know it is! The path north leads to the lower ledge; there is no path south. The drawbridge crossing lies east.
You are on a mighty golden drawbridge above the river. Beyond it stands a magic castle! A river ledge lies west and the castle courtyard lies east.

You are in the courtyard of the magic castle. WOW! This castle is really something! On the wall is inscribed 'hzb tzozi'. The drawbridge lies west and a doorway east leads to the powder magazine. A secret escape tunnel leads south to the riverbank.
You are in the powder magazine of this really super castle. The doorway west leads into the courtyard.
You are on the eastern side of the underground river. A small tunnel leads north through the cliff face into the castle. To the west, a wooden bridge crosses the water.
You stand before a small wooden bridge which crosses the underground river to the east. A narrow service path leads north towards the conduit.

You are in a conduit draining into the river. The water comes up to your knees and is freezing cold. A narrow service path leads south to the wooden bridge while the drains continue east into the cavern network.

# Authoring source: @LABEL targets and {UPPERCASE_CONSTANTS} are resolved by
# tools/caverns-source.mjs. Distributed CAVERNS.BAS needs only native BAZA.
REM CAVERNS - John Hardy (c) 1982-83. Microbee edition copyright 1983.
REM Dreamcards. GNU GPL release 2019; see CAVERNS.TXT and repository LICENSE.
REM Original prose: github.com/jhlagado/caverns src/protected/caverns.basic.
REM Origins: ZX81; VIC-20 port with Ken Stone; Microbee MicroWorld BASIC.
REM Recovery: Microbee Software Preservation Project; Alan Laughton (ChickenMan).
REM Author-approved TEC-OS rewrite. The archival listing is unchanged.
REM Insert experimental lines between these ten-step line numbers.
REM State: rm room, ob objects, db drawbridge, ht hatch, sh shaft, td door.
REM State: cr crypt, cl candle, ft fatigue, tu turns, rp tied rope, gt gate.
REM hb and jf retain reserved CVB2 checkpoint fields. Integers use %.
DIM ob%(24),ex%(216),il%(48),ad$(24),no$(24),di$(3),ve$(26)
GOSUB @LOAD_TABLES
@NEW_GAME:
CLS
GOSUB @RESET_STATE
@BANNER:
PRINT "DREAMCARDS presents..."
PRINT "CAVERNS by John Hardy (c) 1982-83":PRINT "GNU General Public License, 2019":ft%=0:tu%=0
PRINT "Bring treasure home for double points. Take the compass!":PRINT "LOOK describes, INVENTORY lists, SCORE totals, QUIT finishes."
@GAME_LOOP:
REM Apply view-time candle events before rendering; rendering changes no world state.
GOSUB @PREPARE_VIEW
GOSUB @DESCRIBE_ROOM
@COMMAND_LOOP:
GOSUB @READ_COMMAND
GOSUB @PARSE_COMMAND
IF vb%={VERB_LOOK} THEN @GAME_LOOP
IF vb%={VERB_SCORE} THEN GOSUB @COMPUTE_SCORE:PRINT "Your score is";sc%;" out of 126.":GOTO @COMMAND_LOOP
IF vb%={VERB_LIST} THEN GOSUB @INVENTORY:GOTO @GAME_LOOP
IF vb%={VERB_QUIT} THEN @END_ADVENTURE
REM rs is the result; tc is turn cost. Clarifications are free.
rs%=0:tc%=0:ac%=0:GOSUB @SPECIAL_ACTION
IF rs%=0 THEN tc%=1:rs%={REDISPLAY}:GOSUB @FIND_FOE:IF fo%={ITEM_BAT} THEN GOSUB @BAT_TRANSPORT ELSE GOSUB @EXECUTE_COMMAND
GOSUB @ADVANCE_TURN
IF rs%={FINISH} THEN @END_ADVENTURE
IF rs%={PROMPT} THEN @COMMAND_LOOP
GOTO @GAME_LOOP
@END_ADVENTURE:
GOSUB @COMPUTE_SCORE
PRINT:PRINT "Score:";sc%;" out of a possible 126 points in";tu%;" moves.":GOSUB @RANKING:PRINT "Another adventure?"
@PLAY_AGAIN:
INPUT yn$:IF yn$="N" OR yn$="n" THEN END ELSE IF yn$="Y" OR yn$="y" THEN GOTO @NEW_GAME ELSE GOTO @PLAY_AGAIN
END

@LOAD_TABLES:
REM Immutable il: starts and values. Counted prose lines fit the 80-column display.
RESTORE:FOR ix%=1 TO {ROOM_COUNT}:READ dc%:FOR iy%=1 TO dc%:READ ds$:NEXT iy%:NEXT ix%
FOR ix%=1 TO 216:READ ex%(ix%):NEXT ix%
FOR ix%=1 TO {OBJECT_COUNT}:READ ad$(ix%),no$(ix%):NEXT ix%
FOR ix%=1 TO {INITIAL_DATA_COUNT}:READ il%(ix%):NEXT ix%
FOR ix%=0 TO 3:READ di$(ix%):NEXT ix%
FOR ix%=1 TO 26:READ ve$(ix%):NEXT ix%:RETURN
@RESET_STATE:
hb%={ROOM_STRING_BRIDGE}:db%={FATAL}:ht%=0:sh%=0:td%=0:cr%=0:jf%=0:rp%=0:gt%=0
FOR ix%=1 TO {OBJECT_COUNT}:ob%(ix%)=il%(ix%):NEXT ix%
RANDOMIZE
rm%={ROOM_HUT}:cl%=1:fo%=0:it%=0:ft%=0:RETURN
@ADVANCE_TURN:
IF tc%=1 THEN IF tu%<32767 THEN tu%=tu%+1
RETURN
@FIND_FOE:
FOR fo%=1 TO 6:IF ob%(fo%)=rm% THEN RETURN
NEXT fo%:fo%=0:RETURN

@PREPARE_VIEW:
REM The historical candle clock is checked only where the player could see.
vs%=1:ce%=0
IF rm%<18 THEN @VIEW_CLOCK
IF cl%<>1 THEN vs%=0:RETURN
IF ob%({ITEM_CANDLE})=rm% THEN @VIEW_CLOCK
IF ob%({ITEM_CANDLE})<>{CARRIED} THEN vs%=0:RETURN
@VIEW_CLOCK:
IF cl%=1 THEN IF tu%=201 THEN ce%=1
IF cl%=0 OR tu%<230 THEN RETURN
cl%=0:ce%=2:RETURN
@DESCRIBE_ROOM:
PRINT
IF vs%=0 THEN PRINT "It's very dark, too dark to see anything... I'm scared!":GOTO @DESCRIBE_FOES
RESTORE:FOR ix%=1 TO rm%:READ dc%:FOR iy%=1 TO dc%:READ ds$:IF ix%=rm% THEN PRINT ds$
NEXT iy%:NEXT ix%
IF rm%={ROOM_TREASURE_DOOR} THEN IF td%=0 THEN PRINT "The oak door is locked from the inside. Perhaps explosives would open it." ELSE PRINT "The blast has opened a passage east into the treasure room."
IF rm%={ROOM_BALCONY} OR rm%={ROOM_TEMPLE} THEN IF rp%=1 THEN PRINT "The rope hangs securely from the rail to the temple floor."
IF rm%={ROOM_TEMPLE} THEN IF gt% THEN PRINT "To the north is an open gate." ELSE PRINT "To the north is a locked gate."
IF rm%={ROOM_CRYPT} THEN IF cr% THEN PRINT "The stone seal in the eastern wall stands open." ELSE PRINT "Four stones bear the letters V, A, R and D. They seem to spell a name."
IF rm%={ROOM_CELL} THEN IF sh% THEN PRINT "An open ventilation shaft leads east." ELSE PRINT "A rusty grille covers the ventilation shaft. It is too large to carry through."
IF rm%={ROOM_CASTLE_VIEW} THEN IF db%={FATAL} THEN PRINT "A raised drawbridge keeps you from crossing to the castle." ELSE PRINT "A mighty golden drawbridge spans the waters to the east."
IF rm%={ROOM_BASALT_CLEARING} THEN IF ob%({ITEM_DRAGON})={ABSENT} THEN PRINT "You can also see the bloody corpse of an enormous dragon."
IF ce%=1 THEN PRINT "Your candle is growing dim."
IF ce%=2 THEN PRINT "Your candle has gone out."
qt%=0
FOR li%={FIRST_ITEM} TO {OBJECT_COUNT}
IF ob%(li%)<>rm% THEN @NEXT_VISIBLE_ITEM
IF qt%=0 THEN PRINT "You can also see..."
qt%=1:GOSUB @PRINT_OBJECT
@NEXT_VISIBLE_ITEM:
NEXT li%
@DESCRIBE_FOES:
qt%=0:FOR li%=1 TO 6:IF ob%(li%)=rm% THEN GOSUB @FOE_INTRO:IF li%<>{ITEM_WIZARD} AND li%<>{ITEM_DRAGON} AND li%<>{ITEM_DWARF} THEN qt%=qt%+1
NEXT li%:IF qt%=0 THEN @ROOM_PROMPT
PRINT "Nearby there lurks..."
FOR li%=1 TO 6:IF ob%(li%)=rm% THEN IF li%<>{ITEM_WIZARD} AND li%<>{ITEM_DRAGON} AND li%<>{ITEM_DWARF} THEN GOSUB @PRINT_OBJECT
NEXT li%
@ROOM_PROMPT:
PRINT:RETURN
@PRINT_OBJECT:
PRINT "a";ad$(li%);LEFT$(no$(li%),LEN(no$(li%))-1);".":RETURN
@FOE_INTRO:
IF li%={ITEM_WIZARD} THEN PRINT "Before you in a swirling mist stands an evil wizard with his hand held outwards. 'Thou shalt not pass!' he cries.":RETURN
IF li%={ITEM_DRAGON} THEN PRINT "An enormous green dragon guards the cave entrance. Its eyes flicker as it leaps up breathing jets of fire.":RETURN
IF li%={ITEM_DWARF} THEN PRINT "From around the corner trots an old and gnarled dwarf carrying a lantern. 'My job is to protect these stone steps!' he says and lunges at you with his dagger."
RETURN
@INVENTORY:
PRINT "You are carrying ";:qt%=0
FOR li%={FIRST_ITEM} TO {OBJECT_COUNT}
IF ob%(li%)<>{CARRIED} THEN @NEXT_CARRIED_ITEM
IF qt%=0 THEN PRINT
qt%=1:GOSUB @PRINT_OBJECT
@NEXT_CARRIED_ITEM:
NEXT li%
IF qt%=0 THEN PRINT "nothing."
RETURN

@READ_COMMAND:
REM Normalise once; whole words and alias precedence match the qualified game.
INPUT cm$:IF cm$="" THEN @READ_COMMAND ELSE cm$=" "+cm$+" "
FOR ix%=1 TO LEN(cm$):cc%=ASC(MID$(cm$,ix%,1)):IF cc%>64 THEN IF cc%<91 THEN cm$=LEFT$(cm$,ix%-1)+CHR$(cc%+32)+MID$(cm$,ix%+1)
NEXT ix%
IF cm$=" n " THEN cm$=" north "
IF cm$=" s " THEN cm$=" south "
IF cm$=" w " THEN cm$=" west "
IF cm$=" e " THEN cm$=" east "
IF cm$=" i " THEN cm$=" list "
RETURN
@PARSE_COMMAND:
FOR it%={FIRST_ITEM} TO {OBJECT_COUNT}:wd$=no$(it%):GOSUB @FIND_WORD:IF mp%>0 THEN @PARSE_VERB
NEXT it%:it%=0
IF it%=0 THEN wd$=" grill ":GOSUB @FIND_WORD:IF mp%>0 THEN it%={ITEM_GRILLE}
@PARSE_VERB:
FOR vb%=1 TO 26:wd$=ve$(vb%):GOSUB @FIND_WORD:IF mp%>0 THEN @VERB_ALIAS
NEXT vb%:vb%=0:RETURN
@VERB_ALIAS:
IF vb%={VERB_ATTACK} THEN vb%={VERB_KILL} ELSE IF vb%>24 THEN vb%={VERB_LIST}
RETURN
@FIND_WORD:
mp%=0:FOR si%=1 TO LEN(cm$)-LEN(wd$)+1
IF MID$(cm$,si%,LEN(wd$))=wd$ THEN mp%=si%:RETURN
NEXT si%:RETURN

@SPECIAL_ACTION:
REM Validate free clarifications; complete rope/hatch actions return a turn cost.
IF vb%={VERB_KILL} THEN IF it%<>{ITEM_SWORD} THEN PRINT "With what weapon?":rs%={PROMPT}:RETURN
IF vb%={VERB_TIE} THEN @TIE_ROPE ELSE IF vb%={VERB_UNTIE} THEN @UNTIE_ROPE
IF rm%={ROOM_BALCONY} THEN IF vb%={VERB_DOWN} THEN @CLIMB_DOWN
IF rm%={ROOM_TEMPLE} THEN IF vb%={VERB_UP} THEN @CLIMB_UP
IF vb%={VERB_OPEN} AND rm%={ROOM_DRAIN_JUNCTION} THEN wd$=" hatch ":GOSUB @FIND_WORD:IF mp%>0 THEN @OPEN_HATCH
IF ob%({ITEM_GRILLE})={CARRIED} THEN IF rm%={ROOM_CELL} OR rm%={ROOM_SHAFT} THEN rs%={PROMPT}:wd$=" east ":IF rm%={ROOM_SHAFT} THEN wd$=" west "
IF rs%={PROMPT} THEN GOSUB @FIND_WORD:IF mp%>0 THEN PRINT "The grille is too large to fit through the shaft. You must leave it here.":RETURN ELSE rs%=0
RETURN
@TIE_ROPE:
rs%={PROMPT}:IF rm%<>{ROOM_BALCONY} THEN PRINT "There is no suitable rail here.":RETURN
IF it%<>{ITEM_ROPE} THEN PRINT "Tie what?":RETURN
wd$=" rail ":GOSUB @FIND_WORD:IF mp%=0 THEN PRINT "Tie it to what? Try the rail.":RETURN
IF ob%({ITEM_ROPE})<>{CARRIED} THEN PRINT "You must be carrying the rope.":RETURN
ob%({ITEM_ROPE})={ROOM_BALCONY}:rp%=1:PRINT "You tie the rope securely to the stone rail. It reaches the temple floor.":GOTO @SPECIAL_DONE
@UNTIE_ROPE:
rs%={PROMPT}:IF rm%<>{ROOM_BALCONY} OR rp%=0 THEN PRINT "There is no secured rope here.":RETURN
rp%=0:PRINT "You untie the rope from the stone rail.":GOTO @SPECIAL_DONE
@CLIMB_DOWN:
rs%={PROMPT}:IF rp%=0 THEN PRINT "You must tie the rope to the rail before climbing down.":RETURN
rm%={ROOM_TEMPLE}:ft%=0:PRINT "You climb down to the temple floor.":GOTO @SPECIAL_DONE
@CLIMB_UP:
rs%={PROMPT}:IF rp%=0 THEN PRINT "There is no secured rope above you.":RETURN
rm%={ROOM_BALCONY}:ft%=0:PRINT "You climb up to the balcony.":GOTO @SPECIAL_DONE
@OPEN_HATCH:
ht%={ROOM_DRAIN_JUNCTION}:PRINT "You lift the latch. The hatch opens both ways."
@SPECIAL_DONE:
tc%=1:rs%={REDISPLAY}:RETURN

@EXECUTE_COMMAND:
REM Dispatch has no jumps into the input loop; every action returns one result.
IF vb%>18 THEN @SPELL_OR_OBJECT ELSE IF vb%=0 THEN @DIRECTION_OR_OBJECT
IF vb%={VERB_KILL} THEN ac%=3:GOTO @OBJECT_ACTION
IF vb%<5 THEN ac%=vb%:IF ac%>3 THEN ac%=3
IF vb%<5 THEN @OBJECT_ACTION ELSE IF fo%>0 THEN @CREATURE_KILLS
IF vb%<7 THEN PRINT "Nothing happens!"
IF vb%>6 THEN IF vb%<13 THEN PRINT "Please tell me how."
IF vb%>12 THEN PRINT "I can't!"
PRINT:rs%={PROMPT}:RETURN
@DIRECTION_OR_OBJECT:
FOR cn%=0 TO 3:wd$=di$(cn%):GOSUB @FIND_WORD:IF mp%>0 THEN @MOVE
NEXT cn%
@SPELL_OR_OBJECT:
IF vb%={VERB_GALAR} THEN @TELEPORT
IF vb%={VERB_VARD} THEN @CRYPT_WORD
GOTO @OBJECT_ACTION
@MOVE:
IF fo%>0 THEN @CREATURE_KILLS
IF ob%({ITEM_COMPASS})={CARRIED} THEN @DESTINATION ELSE IF ob%({ITEM_COMPASS})=rm% THEN @DESTINATION
PRINT "Without the compass, I lose my bearings!":cn%=INT(RND(1)*4)
@DESTINATION:
ei%=rm%*4+cn%-3:nx%=ex%(ei%):GOSUB @RESOLVE_EXIT
IF rm%={ROOM_TEMPLE} THEN IF nx%={ROOM_CRYPT} AND gt%=0 THEN PRINT "The gate is locked.":rs%={PROMPT}:RETURN
IF rm%={ROOM_DRAIN_JUNCTION} THEN IF nx%={ROOM_CELL} AND ht%=0 THEN PRINT "The service hatch is latched shut.":rs%={PROMPT}:RETURN
IF rm%={ROOM_DRAWBRIDGE} THEN IF nx%={ROOM_COURTYARD} OR nx%={ROOM_CASTLE_VIEW} THEN db%={ROOM_DRAWBRIDGE}
IF nx%=0 THEN PRINT "You can't go that way."
IF nx%={FATAL} THEN PRINT "You stumble and fall into the chasm. You smash into the rocks below.":rs%={FINISH}:RETURN
IF nx%>0 THEN rm%=nx%:ft%=0
RETURN
@RESOLVE_EXIT:
IF nx%=-1 THEN nx%=hb%:RETURN
IF nx%=-2 THEN nx%=td%:RETURN
IF nx%=-3 THEN nx%=cr%:RETURN
IF nx%=-4 THEN nx%=ht%:RETURN
IF nx%=-5 THEN nx%=sh%:RETURN
IF nx%=-6 THEN IF db%={FATAL} THEN nx%=0:RETURN ELSE nx%=db%:RETURN
RETURN
@TELEPORT:
IF fo%>0 THEN @CREATURE_KILLS
ft%=0:PRINT "Suddenly a magic wind carries you to another place...":rm%={ROOM_ENTRANCE}:RETURN
@CRYPT_WORD:
IF rm%<>{ROOM_CRYPT} THEN PRINT "Nothing happens here.":RETURN
PRINT "The eastern wall of the crypt slides open. The passage stays open behind you.":cr%={ROOM_CELL}:RETURN
@BAT_TRANSPORT:
PRINT "The giant bat carries you to its colony.":rm%={ROOM_BAT_COLONY}:ft%=0:ob%({ITEM_BAT})=0:RETURN
@CREATURE_KILLS:
PRINT "The creature strikes before you can defend yourself. You have been killed!":rs%={FINISH}:RETURN

@OBJECT_ACTION:
IF ac%<>0 THEN @VALIDATE_OBJECT
ac%=3:wd$=" get ":GOSUB @FIND_WORD:IF mp%>0 THEN ac%=1:GOTO @VALIDATE_OBJECT
wd$=" drop ":GOSUB @FIND_WORD:IF mp%>0 THEN ac%=2
@VALIDATE_OBJECT:
IF it%<1 THEN IF fo%>0 THEN @CREATURE_KILLS ELSE PRINT "eh?":RETURN
IF ob%(it%)={CARRIED} THEN @OBJECT_PRESENT
IF ob%(it%)=rm% THEN @OBJECT_PRESENT ELSE IF fo%>0 THEN @CREATURE_KILLS ELSE PRINT "Not here.":RETURN
@OBJECT_PRESENT:
IF fo%=0 THEN @APPLY_OBJECT
IF ac%=3 THEN IF it%={ITEM_SWORD} THEN IF ob%({ITEM_SWORD})={CARRIED} THEN @USE_TOOL
GOTO @CREATURE_KILLS
@APPLY_OBJECT:
IF ac%=1 THEN @TAKE_OBJECT ELSE IF ac%=2 THEN @DROP_OBJECT ELSE GOTO @USE_TOOL
@TAKE_OBJECT:
cn%=0:FOR ix%={FIRST_ITEM} TO {OBJECT_COUNT}:IF ob%(ix%)={CARRIED} THEN cn%=cn%+1
NEXT ix%:IF cn%>10 THEN PRINT "You cannot carry more.":RETURN
ob%(it%)={CARRIED}:IF it%={ITEM_GRILLE} THEN sh%={ROOM_SHAFT}
IF it%={ITEM_ROPE} THEN rp%=0
PRINT "You take ";:li%=it%:GOSUB @PRINT_OBJECT:PRINT:RETURN
@DROP_OBJECT:
ob%(it%)=rm%:PRINT "You drop ";:li%=it%:GOSUB @PRINT_OBJECT:PRINT:RETURN
@USE_TOOL:
IF it%={ITEM_BOMB} THEN wd$=" candle ":GOSUB @FIND_WORD:IF mp%>0 THEN it%={ITEM_CANDLE}
IF it%<{ITEM_KEY} THEN @CANNOT_USE ELSE IF it%>{ITEM_ROPE} THEN @CANNOT_USE
IF ob%(it%)<>{CARRIED} THEN IF ob%(it%)<>rm% THEN PRINT "Where? I can't see it.":RETURN
ON it%-18 GOTO @UNLOCK,@SWORD,@CANDLE,@ROPE_HELP
@CANNOT_USE:
PRINT "How am I supposed to use it?":RETURN
@UNLOCK:
IF rm%<>{ROOM_HUT_CLEARING} THEN IF rm%<>{ROOM_TEMPLE} THEN PRINT "It won't open!":RETURN
PRINT "You opened the door.":IF rm%={ROOM_HUT_CLEARING} THEN rm%={ROOM_HUT}:GOSUB @HOMECOMING:RETURN ELSE gt%=1:rm%={ROOM_CRYPT}:RETURN
@SWORD:
IF fo%=0 THEN PRINT "But there's nothing to kill...":RETURN
IF ob%({ITEM_SWORD})<>{CARRIED} THEN PRINT "You aren't carrying that.":RETURN
ft%=ft%+1:IF RND(1)*7+15>ft% THEN @SWORD_RESULT
PRINT "You swing with your sword but miss and the creature smashes your skull.":rs%={FINISH}:RETURN
@SWORD_RESULT:
IF RND(1)<.38 THEN @VICTORY
li%=INT(RND(1)*4):IF fo%={ITEM_BAT} THEN @BAT_TRANSPORT
IF li%=0 THEN PRINT "You attack but the creature moves aside."
IF li%=1 THEN PRINT "The creature deflects your blow."
IF li%=2 THEN PRINT "The foe is stunned but quickly regains its balance."
IF li%=3 THEN PRINT "You miss and the creature strikes back."
RETURN
@VICTORY:
PRINT "The sword strikes home and your foe dies.":ob%(fo%)=0
IF fo%<>{ITEM_DRAGON} THEN PRINT "Suddenly a black cloud descends and the corpse vaporises into nothing."
fo%=0:ft%=0:RETURN
@CANDLE:
IF ob%({ITEM_BOMB})={CARRIED} THEN @IGNITE ELSE IF ob%({ITEM_BOMB})=rm% THEN @IGNITE
PRINT "Nothing to ignite here. Keep your candle safe.":RETURN
@IGNITE:
IF cl%<>1 THEN PRINT "The candle is out; you need a flame.":RETURN
IF rm%<>{ROOM_TREASURE_DOOR} THEN PRINT "BOOM! You are thrown aside. When the smoke clears nothing has changed.":RETURN
IF td%={ROOM_TREASURE_ROOM} THEN PRINT "The passage is already open. Save your bomb.":RETURN
PRINT "The fuse burns away and... BOOM! The door is torn from its hinges. A passage opens to the east.":td%={ROOM_TREASURE_ROOM}:ob%({ITEM_BOMB})=0:RETURN
@ROPE_HELP:
PRINT "Tie the rope to the stone rail before climbing down. Once it is secured you can climb back up to the balcony.":rs%={PROMPT}:RETURN

@COMPUTE_SCORE:
sc%=0:FOR ix%={FIRST_ITEM} TO {LAST_TREASURE}
qt%=il%(ix%+{VALUE_OFFSET}):IF ob%(ix%)={CARRIED} THEN IF rm%={ROOM_HUT} THEN sc%=sc%+qt%*2 ELSE sc%=sc%+qt%
IF ob%(ix%)={ROOM_HUT} THEN sc%=sc%+qt%*2
NEXT ix%:RETURN
@RANKING:
PRINT "This gives you an adventurer's ranking of:"
IF sc%<20 THEN PRINT "Hopeless beginner":RETURN
IF sc%<50 THEN PRINT "Experienced loser":RETURN
IF sc%<100 THEN PRINT "Average Viking":RETURN
IF sc%<126 THEN PRINT "Excellent... but you've left something behind!":RETURN
IF sc%=126 THEN PRINT "Perfectionist and genius!!"
RETURN
@HOMECOMING:
PRINT "Welcome home! Your treasures are safe."
FOR ix%={FIRST_ITEM} TO {LAST_TREASURE}:IF ix%<>{ITEM_COMPASS} THEN IF ix%<>{ITEM_BOMB} THEN IF ob%(ix%)={CARRIED} THEN ob%(ix%)={ROOM_HUT}
NEXT ix%:GOSUB @COMPUTE_SCORE:PRINT "Your score is";sc%;" out of 126.":GOSUB @RANKING
IF sc%=126 THEN PRINT "All treasure home. Your quest is complete!"
PRINT "QUIT to finish, or leave to seek more treasure.":RETURN
END
@WORLD_DATA
